description: 17-question benchmark: 13 must be answered (ground truth from hand-written SQL that does not use the metric catalog), 4 must be refused. Refusals count as correct.

questions.question: What are the top 5 product categories by sales revenue?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT category_reporting, items_price_total FROM analytics.category_performance ORDER BY items_price_total DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How did monthly sales revenue grow during 2018?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT year_month, ROUND(SUM(items_price_total), 2) AS revenue FROM analytics.sales_daily WHERE year = 2018 AND in_candidate_window GROUP BY year_month ORDER BY year_month

questions.question: Which customer states have the highest late delivery rate?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state_std, late_rate FROM analytics.delivery_by_state ORDER BY late_rate DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What share of payment value comes from each payment type?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(100 * SUM(payment_value) / SUM(SUM(payment_value)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM warehouse.fact_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY share_pct DESC

questions.question: Is there a relationship between delivery delays and review scores?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.is_late THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery_status, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS avg_score FROM warehouse.fact_reviews r JOIN warehouse.fact_orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: Which 3 customer states generated the most revenue in 2017?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.customer_state_std, ROUND(SUM(l.line_price_total), 2) AS revenue FROM warehouse.fact_order_lines l JOIN warehouse.fact_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE l.purchase_date >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND l.purchase_date < DATE '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which product categories had the lowest revenue?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT category_reporting, items_price_total FROM analytics.category_performance ORDER BY items_price_total ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2017?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT year_month, SUM(n_orders) AS orders FROM analytics.sales_daily WHERE year = 2017 AND in_candidate_window GROUP BY year_month ORDER BY year_month

questions.question: Which customer states have the longest average delivery time?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state_std, avg_purchase_to_delivery_days FROM analytics.delivery_by_state ORDER BY avg_purchase_to_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What was the total freight cost in 2018?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(items_freight_total), 2) AS freight FROM analytics.sales_daily WHERE year = 2018

questions.question: What share of revenue comes from each seller state?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_state_std, ROUND(100 * SUM(items_price_total) / SUM(SUM(items_price_total)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM analytics.seller_performance GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What is the average order value by customer state?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state_std, ROUND(AVG(items_price_total), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM warehouse.fact_orders WHERE has_items GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What was the average review score of orders purchased in each month of 2018?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT to_char(purchase_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 3) AS avg_score FROM warehouse.fact_reviews WHERE in_candidate_window AND purchase_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND purchase_date < DATE '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
